Frequently Asked Questions

Why does my business need a website?

Today, 85% of consumers research online before buying a product or hiring a service. A professional website builds credibility.

How much does it cost to develop a website?

The cost depends on your needs, but we offer flexible plans tailored to your requirements. Whether you need a basic site or a custom solution, we’ll work within your budget.

I don’t know how to register a .com domain. Can you help?

Absolutely! We handle .com domain registration for you. Once completed, we’ll transfer full ownership and management rights to you.

If I don’t have hosting, does Adhentux provide this service?

Yes! We offer secure, reliable web hosting with regular backups and continuous security updates. Our support ensures your site stays 100% online, 365 days a year.

How do I handle the website content?

We’ll guide you! Based on your business profile and products/services, we help you define, organize, and optimize content to attract your ideal customers.

Will the website look good on all devices?

Definitely! Our designs are fully responsive, meaning they adapt seamlessly to smartphones, tablets, and desktops—no extra effort required.
